name: AI21 Maestro
desc: Agent system that plans and runs data-heavy enterprise tasks
desc_zh: 为规划并执行数据密集型企业任务而生的智能体系统
solves: Long multi-step work derails when a model guesses; Maestro plans the steps and shows each tool call.
solves_zh: 多步骤任务常因模型瞎猜而出错，Maestro 先规划步骤，并展示每次工具调用。
best_for: A due-diligence review needs facts pulled from hundreds of filings by Monday.
best_for_zh: 尽职调查要在周一前从数百份文件里提取事实。
